🌟 portracker | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Real-time network port and service discovery and monitoring for self-hosted environments.
✨ Key Features: • Automatic Port Discovery • Platform-Specific Collectors (Docker, TrueNAS) • Internal Port Detection • Lightweight & Self-Contained (SQLite) • Peer-to-Peer Monitoring
📖 Summary: Portracker is an open-source, self-hosted tool that automatically discovers and monitors network ports and services across your systems. It provides a real-time, accurate map of your network, preventing manual tracking and deployment issues.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ MangoDisk | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To help users free up disk space and understand their storage usage on macOS and Windows through a comprehensive and safe cleaning and analysis tool.
✨ Key Features: • Deep Cleanup (System, App Caches, Browser Data, Developer Tools, Containers, AI Models) • Large File Cleanup • Duplicate File Cleanup • Disk Space Analysis (Treemap visualization) • Privacy Cleanup (Browsing history, cookies, etc.)
📖 Summary: MangoDisk is a cross-platform desktop application for macOS and Windows designed to clean up disk space and analyze storage usage. It offers features like deep cleanup of system and application caches, large file identification, duplicate file removal, and privacy data clearing.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 openscad | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating precise, parametric 3D models for technical and mechanical purposes through a code-like scripting interface.
✨ Key Features: • Script-based 3D modeling • Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) • Extrusion of 2D outlines (DXF support) • Parametric design capabilities • Exports to STL and OFF formats
📖 Summary: OpenSCAD is a free software for creating solid 3D CAD objects using a script-based approach. It functions as a 3D compiler, reading script files to render models, making it ideal for machine parts and parametric designs.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 CodeFormer | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Restoring and enhancing the quality of degraded or low-resolution facial images.
✨ Key Features: • Robust blind face restoration • Codebook Lookup Transformer architecture • Supports various degradation types (low resolution, noise, artifacts) • Face inpainting and colorization capabilities • Integration with Hugging Face, Replicate, and OpenXLab for demos
📖 Summary: CodeFormer is a PyTorch-based framework for robust blind face restoration, utilizing a Codebook Lookup Transformer. It excels at enhancing degraded facial images, including those with low resolution, noise, or artifacts, and also supports inpainting and colorization tasks.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 tegaki | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To create engaging, animated handwriting effects for text content on websites and in digital presentations.
✨ Key Features: • Animates any font into handwriting • No manual path authoring or native dependencies • React component for easy integration • Command-line interface for SVG generation • Supports multiple frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, SolidJS, Astro, Vanilla JS, Web Components)
📖 Summary: Tegaki is a TypeScript library that animates any font into handwriting, creating a stroke-by-stroke drawing effect for the web. It supports various frameworks and offers a command-line interface for generating animated SVGs.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 mcp-searxng | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide AI assistants with privacy-respecting web search capabilities by connecting them to a SearXNG instance.
✨ Key Features: • Integrates SearXNG API for AI web search • Supports MCP clients (Claude, Cursor, etc.) • Privacy-respecting web search • Search with pagination, filters, direct answers • Read HTML, structured text, and bounded PDF text
📖 Summary: This repository acts as an intermediary server, enabling AI assistants like Claude and Cursor to perform web searches through a SearXNG instance. It translates AI assistant requests into SearXNG queries and returns the results, facilitating privacy-respecting web access for AI.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
